title: Launcher must serve in the process the MCP client spawned
observation: os.execv does not replace the process image on Windows. The launcher exited with code 0 during the handshake while a detached grandchild kept the inherited pipes open, so Claude Code timed out after 30s even though the server answered correctly on the pipe.
evidence: before: claude mcp list reported connection timed out after 30000ms
before: probe showed spawned process exit code 0 after 4s while stdout still served
after: claude mcp list reports agent-os Connected
suggested_direction: Resolve the checkout, then import and call the CLI in-process. Keep launcher-verify holding the process open across the handshake so a replacement-process regression fails loudly.
acceptance: The spawned launcher process is still alive when initialize is answered.
claude mcp list reports agent-os connected.
